events.title: Tesla says 300+ Cybercabs are serving Austin
events.summary: Tesla’s own statement on X. It is a company figure, not independent live fleet data.

events.title: Q3 report adds current operating context
events.summary: Tesla reports Austin hours of 6am to midnight and nearly two million cumulative unsupervised Robotaxi miles at quarter end. These are operator-level company figures.

events.title: Dallas Cybercab expansion target
events.summary: Tesla said on its Q3 call, on 21 Oct, that Cybercab rides launch in Dallas next month. No exact launch day was given.

events.title: Tesla lists four cities as coming soon
events.summary: Tesla’s 21 Oct Robotaxi Safety Report lists Las Vegas, Jacksonville, Phoenix and San Antonio as coming soon. No launch dates. TeslaNorth is the opened source; tesla.com/robotaxi/safety returned 403 to our fetcher.

companyClaims.label: Cybercabs serving Austin
companyClaims.note: Company figure; no independent live active-fleet total is established.

companyClaims.label: Installed annual Cybercab manufacturing capacity
companyClaims.scope: Giga Texas; Tesla Q3 installed-capacity table
companyClaims.note: Installed capacity is not actual annual output, registrations or deployed vehicles.

methodology: Texas counts describe vehicles listed on the operator registry, via a named mirror. They are not city allocations or active vehicles.
Only same-scope, same-snapshot registry counts are combined into a fleet share. Regional estimates are shown separately with their source dates.
Tesla-listed availability, reported operation, app boundaries and vehicle observations are independent evidence tracks.
The map shows city records, not live vehicle locations. An app-derived area is not a vehicle-specific guarantee.
Source retrieval, publication, event date and first observation are separate clocks. A month-only target remains month-only.

conflicts.title: Tesla’s city lists differ
conflicts.summary: The general Robotaxi page lists Orlando. The Cybercab FAQ’s Model Y list omits it. The general listing is retained, with vehicle attribution unresolved.

conflicts.title: No verified live Cybercab fleet total
conflicts.summary: Registration counts and Tesla’s 300+ Austin statement are different measures. Neither is a live operating counter.
